Name: WSilenceW's Loose Sleeves(FS)
Author: WSilenceW
Description:
Mod包含两款宽松袖子，一款没有袖口条纹，一款有袖口条纹。袖口条纹可以单独自定义颜色。需要FS前置。

使用FS镜子设置袖子颜色，其中带袖口条纹通过切换图层来设置颜色。

我的小红书账号：韭菜炖大鹅


===================================

This mod includes two loose sleeve styles. One has no cuff stripe. The other has a cuff stripe that can be customized with a separate color. Requires Fashion Sense (FS) as a prerequisite.
Use the FS mirror to set sleeve colors. For the style with a custom cuff, you can change its color by toggling between layers.
